_comment: Reference for DevPanel's own persisted state — not a schema DevPanel provisions for user sites. Regenerate by hand when the Rust structs in src-tauri/src/{workspace/types.rs,workspace/manifest.rs,config/mod.rs} change.

devpanel.sqlite._note: Both tables are key/blob stores — one JSON document per row, not normalized columns. `payload_schema` documents the shape of that JSON.

workspaces.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workspaces (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, payload TEXT NOT NULL)

runtime_profile.php_version: string, "inherit" or a folder name under bin/php/
runtime_profile.database_version: string, "inherit" or a folder name under bin/<engine>/

wordpress_admin._rust: Option<WordPressAdmin>, null unless preset is wordpress

app_state.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS app_state (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, payload TEXT NOT NULL)

config.php_version: string | null (legacy — superseded by per-workspace runtime_profile)
config.www_dir: string, relative to the portable app root, default "www"

app_state._note: config.json next to the sqlite file is a legacy fallback read only when the 'config' row is missing; sqlite is the source of truth going forward.

workspace.json._location: <project_dir>/workspace.json — one per site, lives inside the project folder itself
workspace.json._note: Not in devpanel.sqlite on purpose: this travels with the project and survives an Environment switch without the workspace needing to be recreated. Consumed by the vhost renderers, see docs/vhost-templates.md.
workspace.json.doc_root: string, relative to project folder — e.g. "public" for Laravel, "" for WordPress/Empty
workspace.json.ssl_cert_file: string | null, absolute path to the leaf cert once finish_domain_setup has run
workspace.json.ssl_key_file: string | null, absolute path to the leaf key
